get.description: Returns the organizations the authenticated user belongs to. Call this right after Firebase sign-in to decide whether to show an organization picker (`needsSelection: true`) or proceed straight into the app.

put.description: Marks one of the user's organizations as the default. Subsequent requests are scoped to this organization automatically.

get.description: Returns the full profile of the user's current organization.
Returns the staff record corresponding to the authenticated user inside their current organization.
Returns the flattened list of permission keys granted to the staff member through their assigned roles.
Returns a paginated list of staff members in the user's current organization.

post.description: Creates a new staff member in the user's current organization.

get.description: Returns a single staff member by ID.

patch.description: Enables or disables a staff member without deleting it.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of products. For full-text search by name/SKU/UPC, prefer `GET /api/search/v1/products`.
Returns the images and other media attached to a product, ordered by `order`.

post.description: Returns media for many products at once, keyed by product id. Use this on the catalog grid instead of N+1 requests.

get.description: Returns every UOM configured for the product (e.g. case of 12, six-pack of 6, single unit) with the conversion factor and `isDefault` flag.

post.description: Returns per-product UOM price lists for the given products, honouring the price list assigned to `clientId`. Use this on the catalog and the cart whenever the active client changes.
Returns available stock for many products at once, optionally scoped to a warehouse. Use this on the catalog grid.

get.description: Returns the per-warehouse stock breakdown, plus lots, serials and the recent inventory transactions for a single product.
Returns the lots tracked for a product. The mobile app uses this to surface the nearest-expiring lot on the Product Detail screen.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Free-text on name, RFC and email

get.description: Returns a paginated list of orders. For full-text search across client, folio and invoice number, prefer `GET /api/search/v1/orders`.

parameters.name: deliveryStatusIds
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of delivery status UUIDs

post.description: Creates an order. Set `status: "DRAFT"` to save the cart without confirming, or `"CONFIRMED"` to commit and (optionally) trigger invoice generation with `markAsInvoiced: true`.

put.description: Full replacement of a DRAFT order. For confirmed orders use PATCH semantics on `/status`, `/delivery-status` etc.

patch.description: Advances the order through its delivery timeline (e.g. PENDING → IN_PROGRESS → DELIVERED).
Triggers CFDI generation and stamps the order with an `invoiceNumber`. Idempotent.
Voids an invoiced order. Returns the updated order with `status: "VOIDED"`.

get.description: Returns the CFDI 4.0 invoice PDF. Only valid for orders that have been invoiced.

Returns the full event log for an order — creation, delivery transitions and payment activity — ordered ascending by `occurredAt`. Powers the **SEGUIMIENTO** UI in jadix, storefront and mobile.

Events have a `type` of `GENERAL` (order lifecycle), `DELIVERY` (logistics transitions; `status` carries the new delivery status UUID — resolve via [`/delivery-statuses`](/api-reference/orders/delivery-statuses)) or `PAYMENT` (payment added/removed; `status` is the resulting order payment state and `notes` is `"<amount> <paymentMethodId>"`).

post.description: Records a payment for a client. Use `allocations` to split it across one or more orders.

get.description: Returns the per-organization charge configuration (shipping, IVA, card commissions, etc.) shown in the Cart's CARGOS section.
Returns the ordered list of delivery statuses configured for the organization (e.g. Confirmada, Preparada, En tránsito, Entregada). Drives the timeline scaffold on the order detail screen.
Returns the recent sale prices of a product to a specific client. Drives the "Última venta" hint in the cart.
Full-text search across product name, SKU and UPC, with category, brand, stock, price-range filters and sort. Backs the catalog grid on the mobile app and the products list in Jadix.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Free-text search across name, SKU and UPC

parameters.name: warehouseId
parameters.description: Scope results to products that have an inventory entry in this warehouse. When set, each product's `inventory` array in the response is reduced to **only** the entry for this warehouse — callers operating in a single-warehouse flow (e.g. mobile POS) get a self-consistent view where summing `availableQty` reflects only the chosen warehouse. Without this param, `inventory` returns every warehouse the product exists in.

parameters.name: hasStock
parameters.description: "true" or "false" — filter by in-stock availability (`inventory[].availableQty > 0`). Combine with `warehouseId` to scope the stock check to a single warehouse.

parameters.name: priceMin
parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound on `price`. Negative values are ignored.

parameters.name: priceMax
parameters.description: Inclusive upper bound on `price`. Negative values are ignored.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Result ordering. `relevance` sorts by `catalogPriority` ascending (products without priority go last), tie-broken by `createdAt` descending. Defaults to `created_desc` on this endpoint.

get.description: Full-text search across client name, order folio and invoice number, with the same filter surface as `GET /api/orders/v1`.
Aggregates the same filter set as `GET /api/search/v1/orders` into counts by delivery status and payment status. Drives the badges on the Orders list tabs.

parameters.name: thisWeekFrom
parameters.description: ISO date for the start of the "this week" window

post.description: Returns the total qty incoming for the given products from open purchase orders. Does not break down by PO; see the gap noted in the Product Detail guide.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of quotations scoped to the caller. Sales reps only see quotations they created; managers see every quotation in the org. For full-text search across client and quote number, prefer `GET /api/search/v1/quotations`.

post.description: Creates a quotation in `DRAFT` status. Unlike orders, creating a quotation does **NOT** validate or commit inventory — quotations are a sales proposal, stock is only touched when the quotation is converted to an order.

put.description: Full replacement of a `DRAFT` quotation. Once a quotation is in `CONFIRMED` status (i.e. it has been converted to an order) it is read-only — this endpoint will return `409 Conflict`.

delete.description: Soft-deletes the quotation. Only `DRAFT` quotations can be deleted; converted quotations are kept for audit alongside their order.

patch.description: Transitions a quotation between `DRAFT` and `CONFIRMED`. Note that `CONFIRMED` is also set automatically by `POST /{id}/convert` and once set the quotation becomes read-only — use this endpoint mainly to flip a manually-confirmed quotation back to draft.

post.description:
Creates an `Order` from the quotation, marks the quotation as `CONFIRMED`, and links them via the order's `quoteId` and the quotation's `orderId`.

**Preconditions** (return `409 Conflict` on failure):
- Quotation status must be `DRAFT` and not already converted (`orderId == null`).
- `clientId` must be set — anonymous quotations cannot be converted.
- Every line must have a `warehouseId` — quotations allow lines without a warehouse, but orders do not.

**Side effects** — unlike `POST /api/orders/v1`, conversion runs the full order-create flow on the line items, which means:
- Inventory is validated (the order is rejected if any line has insufficient stock) and shipped against the chosen warehouse.
- The order is created in `CONFIRMED` status, not `DRAFT`.
- Order timeline + Kafka order-created events fire as if the order had been created directly.

If the order creation fails (stock, validation, etc.) the quotation stays in `DRAFT` and no inventory is touched.

get.summary: Last quoted price for client × product
get.description: Returns the most recent unit price quoted to this client for this product — used by the POS / order form to pre-fill the price when re-quoting a known client.

post.description: Returns the total qty currently committed to open quotations for the given products.

bearerAuth.description: Firebase ID token issued after sign-in. Send as `Authorization: Bearer <idToken>`. The token alone determines both the authenticated user and the organization the request is scoped to.

ValidationError.description: Validation failed. Message is localized via `Accept-Language`.

pieces.description: Pieces per UOM (e.g. 12 for a case of 12)

priceMin.description: Lowest `price` across the result set after every filter except `priceMin`/`priceMax` (same drill-down logic as the category and brand facet counts). Use to initialize the lower bound of a price-range slider. Zero when the result set is empty.

priceMax.description: Highest `price` across the result set after every filter except `priceMin`/`priceMax`. Use to initialize the upper bound of a price-range slider. Zero when the result set is empty.

allOf.description: Counts in `facets.categories` are computed with every active filter EXCEPT the category selection; same drill-down logic applies to `facets.brands`. Buckets with `count = 0` are excluded.

effectivePrice.description: Final price used at checkout: overridePrice if set, otherwise calculatedPrice.

defaultActive.description: Whether the charge is pre-checked in the cart by default.

shippingAddressFormatted.description: Single-line rendering of the shipping address. Auto-resolved by the order service from `shippingAddressId` at create/update time. Read-only.

billingAddressFormatted.description: Single-line rendering of the billing address. Auto-resolved by the order service from `billingAddressId` at create/update time. Read-only.

warehouseId.description: Optional on quotations; **required** when converting to an order.

clientId.description: Null for anonymous quotations created from the catalog before a client is known. Must be set before the quotation can be converted to an order.

status.description: `CONFIRMED` is set automatically once the quotation has been converted to an order; once set, the quotation becomes read-only.

source.description: Channel that originated the quotation: `web`, `pos`, `app` or `catalog`.

clientId.description: Optional at quotation creation — quotations may start anonymous and get a client assigned later. Required before `POST /{id}/convert`.

status.description: For `GENERAL` events: the new order status (e.g. `CREATED`, `CONFIRMED`, `CANCELLED`). For `DELIVERY` events: the UUID of the new delivery status (resolve against [`/delivery-statuses`](/api-reference/orders/delivery-statuses)). For `PAYMENT` events: `UNPAID` | `PARTIAL` | `PAID` | `PAYMENT_REMOVED` | `REFUNDED`.

byUserId.description: Populated from the gateway-injected `x-user-id` header when the actor is a user (e.g. a storefront customer).

byStaffId.description: Populated from the gateway-injected `x-staff-id` header when the actor is a staff member.

notes.description: Free-form payload. For `PAYMENT` events when a payment is added: `"<amount> <paymentMethodId>"`. Empty otherwise.

markAsInvoiced.description: When true, the invoice service generates the CFDI synchronously after creating the order.

byDeliveryStatus.description: Counts keyed by delivery status id.
